name: Seenalt — AI Alt Text & Image Optimizer
author: Seenalt

sections.description:
Seenalt uses advanced AI vision technology to automatically generate accurate, descriptive ALT text for your WordPress images. It also provides image optimization to modern formats like WebP and AVIF.

Key Features

  • AI-Powered ALT Text: Generate accurate, contextual ALT text using advanced AI vision models
  • Image Optimization: Convert images to WebP or AVIF formats for faster loading
  • Bulk Processing: Process multiple images at once from your Media Library
  • Multi-language Support: Generate ALT text in multiple languages (English, Portuguese, Spanish)
  • Customizable Settings: Control ALT text length, include page context, and more
  • Processing History: Track all generated ALT text and optimizations

How It Works

  1. Install and activate the plugin
  2. Go to Seenalt in the admin menu
  3. Select images from your Media Library
  4. Click to generate ALT text or optimize images
  5. Review and apply the results

The Free plan includes 10 ALT text generations per month – no registration required!

External Services

This plugin uses an external service to provide AI-powered ALT text generation and image optimization.

Seenalt API

  • Service: Seenalt API (https://wpiaa-api.onrender.com)
  • Purpose: Generate ALT text using AI vision, create image optimization jobs, and return usage status.
  • When data is sent:
    • When opening plugin dashboard/usage screens (site status check).
    • When starting single or bulk ALT/optimization jobs.
    • When checking job status.
  • Consent/control:
    • External image processing can be controlled from plugin settings.
    • If external processing consent is disabled, job processing requests are blocked.
  • Data sent may include:
    • Site URL and hashed site ID.
    • Image data (base64 payload) for processing jobs.
    • Attachment ID, selected language, job type, optimization format, quality, and max ALT length.
    • Optional page/post context text (if enabled in settings).
  • Service policies:
    • Terms of Service: https://seenalt.com.br/terms
    • Privacy Policy: https://seenalt.com.br/privacy

Requirements

  • WordPress 5.8 or higher
  • PHP 7.4 or higher
  • Free plan available – no registration required
sections.installation:
1. Upload the seenalt folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress
  3. Go to Seenalt in the admin menu to start using the plugin
  4. Free plan is activated automatically – start generating ALT text right away
sections.faq:
Do I need to register or get an API key?

No! The Free plan is activated automatically when you install the plugin. You get 10 ALT text generations and 3 image optimizations per month with no registration required. For higher limits, visit seenalt.com.br.

What languages are supported for ALT text?

Currently, the plugin supports English, Portuguese (Brazil), and Spanish for ALT text generation.

What image formats can be optimized?

The plugin can optimize images to WebP and AVIF formats, which provide better compression than JPEG/PNG while maintaining quality.

Is my data secure?

Yes, all data is transmitted securely via HTTPS. Images are processed in real-time and are not stored permanently on our servers.

Can I use this on multiple sites?

The free plan supports a single site. Visit seenalt.com.br for information about plans that support multiple sites.
